items.what: MoE 모델의 다중 턴 서빙에서 HBM 경계를 동적으로 조정하여 expert weight와 KV 캐시 간의 메모리 할당을 최적화한다.

items.gap: GPU (NVIDIA) 기반, MoE 모델 특화, CPU 메모리 계층 구조와 상이.

items.title: Dynamic HBM Repartitioning for Multi-Turn MoE Serving
items.abstract: Long-running multi-turn requests accumulate reusable key-value (KV) state. Once this state exceeds a fixed GPU KV-cache allocation, serving systems evict reusable prefixes, repeat prefill work, and may preempt requests. This pressure is particularly acute for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models: their expert weights occupy most GPU high-bandwidth memory (HBM), even though each token activates only a sparse subset of experts. items.what: RAG에서 과거 쿼리-문서-모델 상호작용을 데이터마이닝하여 재사용 가능한 evidence view를 생성해 KV 메모리와 압축 오버헤드를 줄인다.
items.relation: KV 메모리 최적화와 컨텍스트 압축이 우리 문제와 관련되나, RAG post-retrieval 특화로 prefill 계산 최적화와 정확히 겹치지 않는다.
items.gap: RAG 문서 압축 특화, attention trace 기반, 우리는 prefill 파이프라인 병목 분석.
items.title: REVA: Reusable Evidence View Aggregation for Context-Efficient RAG Serving
items.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves knowledge-intensive large language model (LLM) applications by conditioning generation on retrieved documents, but longer contexts increase latency, key-value (KV) cache memory, and token cost. Post-retrieval compression can reduce this cost, yet existing compressors often operate independently for each query, rely on auxiliary models or rewriting, and introduce online overhead that can offset the benefit of shorter prompts. items.title: Grouped Value Attention: Efficient KV Caching via On-Demand Key Reconstruction
items.abstract: The KV cache is a primary bottleneck for Transformer decoding: its memory footprint and cache-read traffic grow with sequence length. Grouped-query attention (GQA) reduces this cost by sharing key-value heads, but still stores both a key and a value at every step. We introduce Grouped Value Attention (GVA), which stores grouped values and reconstructs content keys with a learned linear map. At inference, the map can be absorbed into the query, eliminating the need to materialize content keys in the intended decode path. all.what: DSL 기반 구현 독립적 성능 평가를 통해 AI 기반 추론 시스템 최적화를 가능하게 하며, compact KV-cache 설계로 3.5-39.5배 디코드 처리량을 달성한다.
all.relation: KV-cache 설계 최적화가 우리의 메모리 효율 문제와 관련되나, GPU 기반 아키텍처 탐색으로 우리 CPU-only 수동 분석과 전제가 다르다.
all.gap: GPU (NVIDIA B300) 기반, 자동 아키텍처 탐색, 우리는 CPU 클러스터 hand-craft 최적화.
all.title: RoofLang: Enabling AI-Driven Architecting of LLM Inference Systems
all.abstract: AI is beginning to make substantive contributions to LLM inference optimization. Existing AI optimizations are predominantly profiling-based. Profiling-bound feedback confines the search to the capabilities and performance of an existing software stack, preventing a fundamentally better architecture of LLM inference systems from being identified. To enable the AI-driven LLM inference system architecting loop, we argue that a general workload representation, a verifiable mutation space, and an implementation-independent evaluator are required. all.what: Agentic LLM 서빙에서 미래 쿼리가 think/act/tool 등 여러 phase를 섞으므로 phase별 query buffer로 KV 제거 정책을 개선한다.
all.relation: KV 캐시 관리와 multi-turn 서빙이 우리 가설과 관련되나, agentic 워크로드 특화로 우리의 단순 prefill 최적화와 다르다.
all.gap: Agentic multi-turn 특화, GPU 기반, 우리는 single-turn prefill 성능 최적화.
all.title: AgentKV: Phase-Aware KV Eviction for Agentic LLMs
all.abstract: Agentic serving can consume orders of magnitude more tokens than chatbot workloads, stressing both KV-cache capacity and decode-time bandwidth. Most KV-eviction methods score cached keys against representative queries drawn from the most recent tokens, assuming future attention resembles recent attention. all.what: 두 개의 vLLM GPU 레플리카가 shared host-memory KV 캐시로 cross-replica prefill 반복을 제거하여, 다중 턴 시간을 31.7초에서 0.6초로 단축한다.
all.relation: Multi-turn KV 재사용이 우리 H3 가설(KV 재활용의 이득)과 직접 관련되며, 정량적 성능 개선을 보여준다.
all.gap: GPU vLLM replicas 기반, host-GPU 메모리 계층, 분산 서빙 시스템 (우리는 단일 클러스터).
hypothesis_notes: H3: 상위 절반 레이어의 KV를 xk에서 직접 산출하면 prefill FLOPs가 ~48 % 감소
all.title: Shared KV Caching for Replicated 27B Inference: Correctness Failures and Performance Boundaries
all.abstract: Shared host-memory caching can avoid repeated prefill when a request moves between inference replicas. Its usefulness depends on both correct state transfer and lost prefix locality. We study two single-GPU 27B vLLM replicas sharing a 256 GiB LMCache pool. After adopting an existing packed-page patch, we isolate a raw-pointer fallback that omits the dependency on the current CUDA stream. Controlled byte tests fail under an imposed delay and pass when the dependency is restored; the existing mixed allocator provides a working deployment path. all.what: Block diffusion에서 상태 공간 모델 기반 O(1) 캐시가 O(L) attention 캐시를 대체하여 256k 토큰에서 메모리와 지연성을 일정하게 유지한다.
all.relation: Diffusion 디코딩과 초장문(256k) 최적화로, 우리의 단문 prefill 최적화와 문제 도메인이 다르다.
all.gap: Diffusion 모델 기반이고 autoregressive 아님, 초장문 세팅, 우리는 0.5~4K prefill 최적화.
all.title: Fixed State, Long Reach: What a Constant-Size Cache Buys Block Diffusion at Scale
all.abstract: Diffusion language models decode tokens in parallel, but their bidirectional denoiser rules out the naive key--value (KV) cache behind fast autoregressive inference. all.what: Tabular foundation model에서 쿼리/키/값을 FP8로 양자화하여 attention 계산을 1.7배 가속화한다.
all.relation: Attention 최적화 기법이나, tabular 도메인 특화이고 우리 H2 가설(S≤4K에서 attention 미지배)과 충돌한다.
all.gap: Tabular 모델 (LLM 아님), attention 병목 가정, 양자화 기반 접근.
all.title: Attention Quantization for Tabular Foundation Models
all.abstract: With the recent rise and adoption of tabular foundation models, optimizing their inference performance becomes an emerging field for efficiency research. While the models are architecturally similar to transformer-based large language models (LLMs), the size and serving patterns differ significantly.
